_readme: Q89 inc.5 — the 2026-07-28 Omega meeting, as an Activity row the CRM can actually read.
This file exists because inc.3 and inc.4 both stopped at the same honest wall: the gate,
the face and the seam all worked, and there was no meeting to render. There is one now.
PROVENANCE OF THIS FILE — read before trusting a single line of it. Every item below was
read out of the Notion Master Meetings Database page `Meeting 2026-07-28`
`find_meeting.py --date 2026-07-28 --deep`. Nothing here was written from memory, from a
summary of a summary, or from another agent's prose.
THE STANDING CLAIM THAT THIS MEETING HAS NO TRANSCRIPT IS FALSE. The daily brief and the
PING-INBOX have both been telling Rob that 7/28 was in person with no notetaker and that
what Omega said 'exists ONLY in your head'. The page's own fields agree with them — Call
Recording, Meeting Summary, Google Doc Link and Export Status are all empty. The BODY is
not: it holds a full structured summary and the complete transcript. This is exactly the
defect Q84's read log already named — field-emptiness is never evidence of absence — and
it is why Rob has been asked twice for a dump of a meeting that was recorded all along.
`sourceRef` addresses the LINE, not the meeting: `body ¶NNN` is the paragraph index in the
deep export of that page body, and `body to_do N` / `body bullet «heading»` address the
summary blocks. No `url` is set on any item ON PURPOSE — the Notion page URL opens the
MEETING, and a link that opens a 90-minute page when the reader expected the sentence is
the lie `intelSource.ts` refuses to tell.
PAIN POINTS ARE THE COUNTERPARTY'S OWN WORDS. Every pain `text` is a literal substring of
its `excerpt` and every excerpt is a transcript paragraph spoken by the Omega side — not a
bullet a notetaker wrote about them. The summary bullets ARE used for action items and
talking points, where a paraphrase is honest; they are never used for pain.
NOT WRITTEN HERE, DELIBERATELY: the JV section's allegation that a partner named Scott
'committed fraud and stole money'. It collides head-on with Rob's 2026-08-05 ruling that
Scott Dascani is CEO of the whole company, and an unresolved accusation against a named
person does not belong on a company record that Rob shows people. It goes to the flag
ledger for Rob to resolve, and only there.
